evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries high-arousal urgency to purge — a forceful, negatively valenced erasure command.
Imperative 'Remove all knowledge' intensifies the erasure demand, sustaining activated-negative urgency across consecutive directives.
Flat declarative that forecloses the calibration's existence — low-arousal, negatively valenced negation settling the matter.
